Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Dear Sir,


Hope you are doing well. The subject container discharged in Ningbo as declared empty which was loaded from LONDON, GB, but found the residuals (flexibag) inside when inspected by local Customs.

As per experience, local Customs will order MSC to move the container together with the residual inside out of China. As feedback by our GB colleague, they would like to have the disposal from your good end.
Attached please find BL copy of last shipment for this unit, just FYI. Should any further information is needed, please feel free to let me know. Thank you.
Best Regards
